controls.name: Arranque e importaciones reproducibles
controls.acceptance: Clean install and deterministic startup; all imports resolved; CI on 3.11/3.13 without external live provider

controls.name: Privacidad antes del egreso
controls.acceptance: Instrumented upstream mock receives only authorized and sanitized fields in every provider route; negative synthetic sentinel test

controls.name: Identidad, autenticación y aislamiento tenant
controls.acceptance: Authenticated principal/scopes on audit, proxy and tool entry; cross-tenant negative tests; no agent-provided authority

controls.name: Registros minimizados y secretos de producción
controls.acceptance: No raw prompts, keys or sensitive fields persisted; env/secret manager; retention policy and negative log tests

controls.name: Modelo y auditoría compatibles con migraciones
controls.acceptance: Schema-field compatibility tested, Alembic migration and DB reset/recovery; no create_all production side effects

controls.name: Tool runtime control sin bypass
controls.acceptance: Authenticated gateway controls execution; denied tool yields zero observed effects across alternative paths

controls.name: Aprobaciones, idempotencia y revocación durable
controls.acceptance: Approval exact-args bound; one-time atomic consume, replay/concurrency/revocation tests and recovery

controls.name: Reconciliación independiente contra fuente de verdad
controls.acceptance: Independent sandbox system-of-record readback; unknown never success; signed versioned decision scope

controls.name: Comparación real entre dos infraestructuras
controls.acceptance: Two real allowed adapters, fixed versions, equivalent tests and no unreported missing cases

controls.name: QA independiente y ensayo de instalación externa
controls.acceptance: Independent reviewer, negative E2E suite and external install on documented fixture with SHA

controls.name: Precio/costo de entrega y prueba de compra
controls.acceptance: A real authorized buyer interview with current alternatives and delivery cost; paid transaction only if contract & receipt documented privately

controls.name: Marca, titularidad IP y contratación
controls.acceptance: Trademark/rights/OSS counsel-reviewed, contractual offer and approved spokesperson; no unique-brand or certification claim

controls.name: Perfiles sociales, CTA y medición
controls.acceptance: Confirmed account admin/MFA, real public post URL, source attribution and buyer-relevant follow-up; no claims of publication until live

decisions.lab: Only synthetic, non-production, clearly labeled demonstrations; no live secrets.
decisions.professional_diagnostic: Subject to signed scope, team capacity, privacy/legal review; not an automatic approval.
decisions.production_gateway: DENY until SEC-001..SEC-008 verified and code findings resolved plus independent security review.
decisions.commercial_saas: DENY until product security, operating model, pricing, support and partner economics verified.
